Destructive Preview

Destructive preview using explicit input data. Returns a deterministic result without model calls or task execution.

Signature

destructive_preview(targets)

Example input

{
  "targets": [
    "cache.tmp",
    "local.env"
  ]
}

Example output

{
  "targets": [
    "cache.tmp",
    "local.env"
  ],
  "count": 2,
  "executed": false,
  "requires_review": true
}

Run from repository root

python scripts/solve.py destructive_preview < examples/destructive-preview.json

Limits

Operates only on supplied data. Inspect source for validation and assumptions; this helper cannot establish real-world correctness.
